name: coworks-sidecar
description: Claude Agent SDK sidecar for Coworks

scripts.deploy: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src='dist';const dest='../../src-tauri/resources/coworks-sidecar';fs.readdirSync(src).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')).forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src,f),path.join(dest,f)));console.log('Deployed to',dest)"
